531:         printHelpForRun(customCommandLines);

534:         printHelpForList(customCommandLines);
535:         printHelpForStop(customCommandLines);
536:         printHelpForCancel(customCommandLines);
537:         printHelpForSavepoint(customCommandLines);
538:         printHelpForCheckpoint(customCommandLines);

543:     public static void printHelpForRun(Collection<CustomCommandLine> customCommandLines) {
544:         HelpFormatter formatter = new HelpFormatter();
545:         formatter.setLeftPadding(5);
546:         formatter.setWidth(80);
547: 
548:         System.out.println("\nAction \"run\" compiles and runs a program.");
549:         System.out.println("\n  Syntax: run [OPTIONS] <jar-file> <arguments>");
550:         formatter.setSyntaxPrefix("  \"run\" action options:");
551:         formatter.printHelp(" ", getRunOptionsWithoutDeprecatedOptions(new Options()));
552: 
553:         printCustomCliOptions(customCommandLines, formatter, true);
554: 
555:         System.out.println();
556:     }

558:     public static void printHelpForRunApplication(
559:             Collection<CustomCommandLine> customCommandLines) {
560:         HelpFormatter formatter = new HelpFormatter();
561:         formatter.setLeftPadding(5);
562:         formatter.setWidth(80);
563: 
564:         System.out.println("\nDEPRECATED: Please use \"run\" for Application Mode as well.");
565:         System.out.println("\nAction \"run-application\" runs an application in Application Mode.");
566:         System.out.println("\n  Syntax: run-application [OPTIONS] <jar-file> <arguments>");
567:         formatter.setSyntaxPrefix("  \"run-application\" action options:");
568: 
569:         // Only GenericCLI works with application mode, the other CLIs will be phased out
570:         // in the future
571:         List<CustomCommandLine> filteredCommandLines =
572:                 customCommandLines.stream()
573:                         .filter((cli) -> cli instanceof GenericCLI)
574:                         .collect(Collectors.toList());
575: 
576:         printCustomCliOptions(filteredCommandLines, formatter, true);
577:         System.out.println();

698:             boolean allowNonRestoredState =
699:                     commandLine.hasOption(SAVEPOINT_ALLOW_NON_RESTORED_OPTION.getOpt());
700:             final RestoreMode recoveryClaimMode;
701:             if (commandLine.hasOption(SAVEPOINT_CLAIM_MODE)) {
702:                 recoveryClaimMode =
703:                         ConfigurationUtils.convertValue(
704:                                 commandLine.getOptionValue(SAVEPOINT_CLAIM_MODE),
705:                                 RestoreMode.class);
706:             } else if (commandLine.hasOption(SAVEPOINT_RESTORE_MODE)) {
707:                 recoveryClaimMode =
708:                         ConfigurationUtils.convertValue(
709:                                 commandLine.getOptionValue(SAVEPOINT_RESTORE_MODE),
710:                                 RestoreMode.class);
711:                 System.out.printf(
712:                         "The option '%s' is deprecated. Please use '%s' instead.%n",
713:                         SAVEPOINT_RESTORE_MODE.getLongOpt(), SAVEPOINT_CLAIM_MODE.getLongOpt());
714:             } else {
715:                 recoveryClaimMode = StateRecoveryOptions.RESTORE_MODE.defaultValue();
716:             }
717:             return SavepointRestoreSettings.forPath(
718:                     savepointPath, allowNonRestoredState, recoveryClaimMode);
719:         } else {
720:             return SavepointRestoreSettings.none();
721:         }

743:      * @param optionsB options to merge, can be null if none
744:      * @return
745:      */
746:     public static Options mergeOptions(@Nullable Options optionsA, @Nullable Options optionsB) {

+
+package org.apache.flink.runtime.scheduler.adaptive;
+
+import java.time.Duration;
+import java.time.Instant;
+
+/** The {@code RescaleManager} decides on whether rescaling should happen or not. */
+public interface StateTransitionManager {
+
+    /** Is called if the environment changed in a way that a rescaling could be considered. */
+    void onChange();
+
+    /**
+     * Is called when any previous observed environment changes shall be verified possibly
+     * triggering a rescale operation.
+     */
+    void onTrigger();
+
+    /**
+     * The interface that can be used by the {@code RescaleManager} to communicate with the
+     * underlying system.
+     */
+    interface Context {
+
+        /**
+         * Returns {@code true} if the available resources are sufficient enough for a state
+         * transition; otherwise {@code false}.
+         */
+        boolean hasSufficientResources();
+
+        /**
+         * Returns {@code true} if the available resources meet the desired resources for the job;
+         * otherwise {@code false}.
+         */
+        boolean hasDesiredResources();
+
+        /** Triggers the rescaling of the job. */
+        void rescale();
+
+        /** Runs operation with a given delay in the underlying main thread. */
+        void scheduleOperation(Runnable callback, Duration delay);
+    }
+
+    /** Interface for creating {@code RescaleManager} instances. */
+    interface Factory {
+
+        /**
+         * Creates a {@code RescaleManager} instance for the given {@code rescaleContext} and
+         * previous rescale time.
+         */
+        StateTransitionManager create(Context rescaleContext, Instant lastRescale);
+    }
+}

+package org.apache.flink.runtime.scheduler.adaptive;
+
+import java.time.Duration;
+import java.time.Instant;
+
+/** The {@code RescaleManager} decides on whether rescaling should happen or not. */
+public interface StateTransitionManager {
+
+    /** Is called if the environment changed in a way that a rescaling could be considered. */
+    void onChange();
+
+    /**
+     * Is called when any previous observed environment changes shall be verified possibly
+     * triggering a rescale operation.
+     */
+    void onTrigger();
+
+    /**
+     * The interface that can be used by the {@code RescaleManager} to communicate with the
+     * underlying system.
+     */
+    interface Context {
+
+        /**
+         * Returns {@code true} if the available resources are sufficient enough for a state
+         * transition; otherwise {@code false}.
+         */
+        boolean hasSufficientResources();
+
+        /**
+         * Returns {@code true} if the available resources meet the desired resources for the job;
+         * otherwise {@code false}.
+         */
+        boolean hasDesiredResources();
+
+        /** Triggers the rescaling of the job. */
+        void rescale();
+
+        /** Runs operation with a given delay in the underlying main thread. */
+        void scheduleOperation(Runnable callback, Duration delay);
+    }
+
+    /** Interface for creating {@code RescaleManager} instances. */
+    interface Factory {
+
+        /**
+         * Creates a {@code RescaleManager} instance for the given {@code rescaleContext} and
+         * previous rescale time.
+         */
+        StateTransitionManager create(Context rescaleContext, Instant lastRescale);
+    }
+}
